label: Worry score, 5 common items, 0-1 (comparable across all waves)
derivation: Mean of the five worry items asked in identical form in every wave (food, drinking water, violent crime, severe weather, mental health), scored very worried 1, somewhat worried 0.5, not worried 0. All five must be answered.

label: Worry score, 7 items, 0-1 (comparable 2021-2025)
derivation: As worry_score plus worry about traffic accidents and about your own work. The six items put to everyone must be answered; the work item, asked of workers only, counts where present.

label: Worry index as published by LRF for this wave
derivation: Worried.Index as published for wave 2 (from trend_wrp_21_OLD.sav): Rasch-weighted, min-max scaled, over the seven 2021 worry items. Not comparable across waves: both the item set and the construction change. Use worry_score for trends.

label: Experience score, 5 common items, any experience, 0-1 (comparable across waves)
derivation: Proportion of the five common items on which the respondent reports harm in the past two years. Counts personally experienced, knows someone who has, and both. This matches LRF's own harm_*_trended recode and is the series that lines up with 2019. All five items must be answered.

label: Experience score, 5 common items, personally experienced, 0-1
derivation: Counts personally experienced and both, excluding knows someone who has. Comparable 2021-2025 and consistent with the published wave 3 experience index. Against 2019 it drops sharply, because the added knows-someone option pulls self-reports out of the personal category.

label: Experience score, 7 items, any experience, 0-1 (comparable 2021-2025)
derivation: As experience_score plus harm from traffic accidents and from work. All seven items must be answered.

label: Experience index as published by LRF for this wave
derivation: Experienced.Index as published for wave 2 (from trend_wrp_21_OLD.sav).

label: worry_score minus experience_score
derivation: worry_score minus experience_score, both on the five common items.

label: Resilience Index, 0-1
derivation: resilience_index from trended_wrp.sav, which recomputes the wave 2 index consistently with wave 3. Where that file has no row (505 Jamaica cases) the wave 2 release value is used. The two agree exactly for 98.7% of cases; they differ only in Vietnam and Myanmar, where the question wording differs.

label: Resilience Index, 0-100
derivation: resilience_index multiplied by 100.

label: Resilience: individual dimension, 0-1
derivation: resilience_idv_0_100_scale from trended_wrp.sav, divided by 100. Missing for the 505 Jamaica cases absent from that file.

label: Resilience: household dimension, 0-1
derivation: resilience_hhl_0_100_scale from trended_wrp.sav, divided by 100. Missing for the 505 Jamaica cases absent from that file.

label: Resilience: community dimension, 0-1
derivation: resilience_com_0_100_scale from trended_wrp.sav, divided by 100. Missing for the 505 Jamaica cases absent from that file.

label: Resilience: society dimension, 0-1
derivation: resilience_soc_0_100_scale from trended_wrp.sav, divided by 100. Missing for the 505 Jamaica cases absent from that file.
